reserveReview.rationale: Exhibit B of the KPMG-examined USDP report at July 31, 2026 records $24,935,703 cash and $7,040,000 Treasury-collateralized reverse repos, totaling $31,975,703. Rounded weights are 77.98% and 22.02%. The repo matures August 3, three calendar days after the Friday observation, despite being described as overnight; collateral may not be sold or repledged. No government money-market funds or direct Treasury obligations were held.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of the USDP Redemption Assets Report, Exhibit B as of July 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report identifies the complete asset-type composition. Individual commercial-bank and broker-dealer counterparties are anonymized, but no reserve asset class is unclassified.
